name: What are common exterior pathway safety improvements?

mainEntity.name: What are common exterior pathway safety improvements?

acceptedAnswer.text: Exterior pathway safety improvements involve enhancing the safety and accessibility of outdoor walking surfaces. Common improvements include repairing cracks and uneven surfaces, installing adequate lighting, adding non-slip coatings, improving drainage to prevent water accumulation, and ensuring clear, unobstructed pathways. Handrail installation or repair, especially on steps or inclines, also significantly boosts safety. These measures reduce trip and fall hazards, improve visibility, and make pathways safer for everyone.
